findings.desc: scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs:4972-5034 exact-mapping mutation false-green: collectLiteralDoneOracleRowIds accepts every literal id property anywhere in done-oracle.ts, and checkDonePreflightPredicateInventory verifies only that the declared row id exists, not that the row emits the mapped blocker code or consumes the corresponding predicate. Executing the exact checker functions in memory with future_done_predicate mapped to the unrelated existing test-evidence row and artifact:delivery-check.json returned errors:[]; therefore a future DONE predicate can be added, falsely mapped to an unrelated row, and the promised omission guard still passes while done_prepare remains divergent. This directly violates CHK-003 and can make lifecycle readiness evidence misleading; require the checker/mutation test to reject wrong-row mappings by proving code-to-row/predicate correspondence, not mere set membership.

findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: docs/requirements/decisions/done-prepare-automation-execution-plan.md:163-168 promises that DONE/preflight parity is mechanically guarded, but scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs:4972-5034 collects every literal id anywhere in done-oracle.ts and checks only row-id set membership. A future literal DONE blocker can therefore be mapped to an unrelated existing row/process fact and the verifier passes without done_prepare consuming that predicate; the in-memory test at 5062-5074 covers only an entirely unmapped code. This leaves the advertised future-divergence guard incomplete and can again make DONE readiness evidence misleading. Require a wrong-row/wrong-predicate mutation to fail by mechanically binding each blocker code to the corresponding oracle predicate/row behavior. Same root cause independently registered as B-212f:F-001.

findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: docs/requirements/decisions/done-prepare-automation-execution-plan.md:163-171 promises an exact shared predicate guard and wrong-predicate mutation proof, but scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs:4978-5001/5132-5136 compares only overlapping reference names and ignores boolean polarity and the branch containing doneBlockerRow. Independent in-memory execution inverted the real finish-decision oracle branches so missing finishDecision produced doneCheckRow(pass) while present finishDecision produced doneBlockerRow(fail); the unchanged production verifier still exited 0 and printed DONE/preflight predicate inventory parity passed plus Process-fact contract verification passed. Thus wrong-row coverage improved, but an opposite predicate with the same identifier remains false-green and F-001/F-002 closure is incomplete. Require semantic guard/branch correspondence and a polarity-inversion mutation that must fail.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by proof-or-stop-implementer commit 1002a29499cca1a0a57d4cd5ec9a561156076665. The checker now compares normalized blocker-emitting branch semantics including polarity and root-value provenance, in addition to exact code-to-row and rows.push emission. The old checker was proven RED by inverted real branches, opposite-polarity same-name predicates, and same-text/different-provenance mutations; owner then reran process-fact and parity commands and refreshed all 13 receipts.

findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs:4978-5137 treats a shared predicate as any identical identifier/property-access text and ignores operators, polarity, call identity, and value provenance. Executing the exact production checker in memory with machine storyId.length > 0 returning [future_done_predicate], oracle storyId.length === 0 pushing the exact doneBlockerRow(future_done_predicate, test-evidence, ...), a matching inventory entry, and an L4 gate-evidence fact returned errors:[]. The two surfaces block on mutually exclusive states. Therefore commit 2480d37f rejects the old unrelated-row mutation but still does not deliver docs/requirements/decisions/done-prepare-automation-execution-plan.md:163-171 claim that wrong-predicate future divergence is mechanically guarded. Require a semantic same-predicate binding or an inverse-polarity mutation that the production checker must reject; lexical reference intersection is false assurance.
